turns.user_message: Do I get any perks for being a long-time member?
turns.agent_response:
Perks in the Momentum program are based on Tier Credits earned through play and spending rather than the length of time you have been a member. Higher tiers such as Ascend or Soar provide benefits like priority restaurant seating, complimentary valet, and a dedicated host. 

Based on your 20-year history, you may be eligible for these types of rewards or personalized offers tied to your specific level of play. You can confirm your current tier status and point balance at any Momentum Desk or via the Mohegan Sun mobile app. Many of our long-term guests find that having a dedicated host helps streamline their visits—would you like me to find out if you qualify for a host introduction?
